name: Jason Crow
stance: Wants Congress to vote on AI guardrails and opposes AI use for mass surveillance or autonomous lethal weapons, criticizing the Pentagon's pressure on Anthropic.

statements.text: A.I. should not be used for mass surveillance of Americans or autonomous lethal weapons. Trump and Hegseth are trying to punish companies that won’t bend the knee to their demands.
Congress has a responsibility to act on AI. Instead of voting and debating on proper guardrails, Speaker Johnson sent us home early.
